SELECT id,
    organization_id,
    name,
    phone,
    username,
    is_active,
    is_admin,
    is_admin_akabiz,
    use_test_workflow,
    deleted_at,
    expiration_date,
    max_running_zalo_web_accounts,
    max_running_facebook_accounts
   FROM org_staff
  WHERE (( SELECT private.aka_agent_staff_scope_for_request() AS aka_agent_staff_scope_for_request)) IS NULL OR id = (( SELECT private.aka_agent_staff_scope_for_request() AS aka_agent_staff_scope_for_request));
